Typical size (median area in sqm, using only listings whose stated area is plausible):
- villa: median 366 sqm (based on 8,357 of 11,424 listings that state an area)
- land: median 800 sqm (based on 5,068 of 5,068 listings that state an area)
- building: median 800 sqm (based on 1,454 of 1,454 listings that state an area)
- rest house: median 800 sqm (based on 332 of 332 listings that state an area)
- furnished apartment: median 156 sqm (based on 23 of 27 listings that state an area)
- furnished villa: median 400 sqm (based on 3 of 3 listings that state an area)
- No reliable size figure for: apartment, floor (more than 30% of the stated areas in their URLs are implausibly large).
Apartment listings by bedroom count: 1 bed: 4,412, 2 bed: 5,912, 3 bed: 14,398, 4 bed: 6,188, 5 bed: 3,425, 6 bed: 1,230, 7 bed: 222
Most common facing directions (villas/land/buildings): east (4,307), north (4,224), south (3,794), west (2,867), north east (438)
Note: these are counts of listing URLs in Wasalt's public sitemap, not verified market data. Many apartment and floor URLs state areas that are far too large to be real (for example tens of thousands of sqm), so those values were excluded from the size statistics. The sitemap does not contain prices.
